title: Selecting Shots for Demographic Fairness in Few-Shot Learning with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and mitigating demographic bias (specifically race and gender) in LLMs using algorithmic fairness metrics. The study does not evaluate moral reasoning, religious knowledge, or spiritual traditions.
